questions.question: What is the primary function of data collector jobs in Performance Analytics?

options.text: To create new indicators automatically
To take periodic snapshots of process tables and store them in Scores and Snapshots tables
To export dashboard data to external systems
To validate indicator configurations

explanation.correct: The Data Collector is the engine that takes periodic snapshots of your process tables and stores them in the Scores and Snapshots tables.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Data collector jobs collect scores; indicators must be created manually or through other means.
Data collection is for internal score collection, not external export.
Validation is done through diagnostics, not data collector jobs.

source.excerpt: Data collector is the engine that takes periodic snapshots of your process tables and stores them in the Scores and Snapshots tables.

questions.question: What is the recommended relationship between a data collector job's schedule and an indicator source's frequency?

options.text: The job should run more frequently than the indicator frequency
The job schedule should match the indicator source frequency
The job should run less frequently than the indicator frequency
There is no relationship between job schedule and indicator frequency

explanation.correct: Usually set a job schedule to match the frequency in the indicator source.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Running more frequently than needed wastes resources without collecting new data.
Running less frequently would miss collection periods defined in the indicator source.
The job schedule should align with indicator frequency for optimal data collection.

source.excerpt: Usually set a job schedule to match the frequency in the indicator source.

questions.question: Which type of data collection job should be run only once to populate empty indicators?

options.text: Daily data collection job
Historical data collection job
Automated data collection job
Scheduled data collection job

explanation.correct: You can set up jobs that run manually, such as historical jobs, which you run only when collecting data for a new indicator.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Daily jobs run on a schedule, not as one-time historical collection.
Automated jobs are scheduled to run regularly, not for one-time historical population.
Scheduled jobs run repeatedly; historical jobs are run once to backfill data.

source.excerpt: You can also set up jobs that run manually, such as historical jobs, which you run only when collecting data for a new indicator.

questions.question: Which two actions should be performed in the 'Collect data' phase of PA implementation? (Choose two.)

options.text: Schedule and activate data collector jobs
Create dashboard visualizations
Run historical data collector jobs as a one-off
Define business goals and measurements

explanation.correct: In the Collect data phase, collection jobs need to be configured to run with the desired frequency and activated, and historical data collector jobs should be run as a one-off to populate empty indicators.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Dashboard creation is part of the 'Share results' phase, not data collection.
Defining goals is part of the 'Plan and Prepare' phase, not data collection.

source.excerpt: Collect data: Collection jobs need to be configured to run with the desired frequency and activated. Schedule and activate data collector jobs. Run historical data collector jobs as a one-off to populate empty indicators.

questions.question: What happens when one data collection job generates scores for multiple indicators?

options.text: Each indicator receives a separate job
This is not possible; each job collects for one indicator only
One job usually generates scores for multiple indicators that use the same indicator source
The job fails due to conflicts

explanation.correct: One job usually generates scores for multiple indicators that use the same indicator source.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Jobs are not automatically separated; one job can handle multiple indicators with the same source.
A single job can collect for multiple indicators sharing an indicator source.
Multiple indicators per job is normal behavior, not a conflict.

source.excerpt: One job usually generates scores for multiple indicators that use the same indicator source.

questions.question: What is the purpose of Performance Analytics diagnostics?

options.text: To schedule data collection jobs
To identify and diagnose configuration issues using predefined scripts
To create new indicator sources
To export collected scores to external systems

explanation.correct: Performance Analytics diagnostics identify and diagnose configuration issues using predefined scripts that examine the database for invalid records and provide suggestions to resolve issues.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Job scheduling is done in the PA Admin Console, not diagnostics.
Indicator sources are created manually, not through diagnostics.
Export functionality is separate from diagnostics.

source.excerpt: Identify and diagnose configuration issues using predefined scripts that examine the database for invalid records and provide suggestions to resolve issues.
